idea: Neighborhood recycling bin with a camera sorts common contamination items (plastic bags, food waste) out of the recycling stream automatically before pickup, refusing bins more than 10% contaminated and texting the resident why.
customer: The residents of the neighborhood whose bins get sorted and who get texted when a bin is rejected, and the municipal or HOA waste-management staff who currently inspect bins and enforce contamination rules by hand.
pieces: not decomposed -- moved here from problems/ during cleanup: its old pieces were hand-authored by Claude before the 'never predefine the pieces' rule was established. See BRIDGE.md and README.md.
